response.sql: WITH cat AS (SELECT category, AVG((spent - amount) * 1.0 / amount) AS avg_rel_overspend, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM budget GROUP BY category), g AS (SELECT AVG(line_count * 1.0) AS avg_lines FROM cat) SELECT AVG(cat.avg_rel_overspend) AS avg_of_avg_rel_overspend, AVG(cat.line_count * 1.0) AS avg_line_count, AVG(cat.line_count - g.avg_lines) AS avg_excess_over_avg_line_count FROM cat CROSS JOIN g WHERE cat.line_count > g.avg_lines;

assumptions.assumption: The line count is the total number of budget rows in each category, including rows whose relative overspend is NULL. The per-category average line count is computed over all categories, before the filter.
Rows with amount = 0 give a NULL ratio in SQLite (division by zero), so they are ignored in the average overspend but still counted as lines. Rows with NULL spent or amount are handled the same way.
